description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the trophy hall at its grandest: a great stone hall with a high dark teal shingle roof on carved timber beams with carved beast-head beam ends, a wide open front, the walls full of mounted beast heads, antlers, bear and wolf pelts and fangs, a huge horned monster skull over the door, crossed spears and burning torches by the entrance

references.usage: the first, smallest stage of this same building, chosen by the author: keep its stone, timber, roof colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw the bigger, richer next stage of it
